props.name: values
props.description: The history, evenly spaced, oldest first.

props.name: period
props.description: Season length in steps — 7 for daily data with a weekly cycle, 12 for monthly data.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Steps to forecast. Defaults to one season.

props.name: seasonality
props.description: Additive when the seasonal swing stays the same size; multiplicative when it grows with the level.

props.name: params
props.description: Fixed smoothing weights. Leave out to fit them by minimising squared one-step error.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Names step `index` — a date, a month. Indexes past the history are forecast steps.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: showFitted
props.description: Draw the model's one-step predictions over the history.

props.name: showMetrics
props.description: Show the fitted weights and error metrics under the chart.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: onFit
props.description: Called with the fitted model whenever it is refitted.
